tools.name: pabandi_verify_passport
tools.description: Verify a Pabandi PTP attestation (agent/business/individual/trust rail). Input base64-encoded attestation token and optional need (e.g. "act:book"). Returns valid, grantedCapabilities, riskBand, expiresAt. Works offline. Example: {"token": "...base64...", "need": "act:book"}

tools.name: pabandi_verify_zk_trust_proof
tools.description: Verifies a Pabandi Zero-Knowledge Trust Passport to ensure a counterparty meets trust thresholds without revealing raw data.

tools.name: pabandi_submit_dispute_evidence
tools.description: Uploads a photo or PDF as evidence for a disputed work order.

tools.name: pabandi_discover
tools.description: Get PTP discovery (public). Returns verify endpoint, public key, issue endpoint, risk bands, entity types. No auth required.

tools.name: pabandi_check_sharia_compliance
tools.description: Returns the Sharia compliance status, audit certificates, and prohibited feature flags for the Pabandi platform.

tools.name: pabandi_create_payment_intent
tools.description: Create an orchestrated, multi-rail payment request. Automatically selects optimal rail (Solana USDC, SBP Raast, Card, Mobile Money) with automatic failover, double-entry ledgering, and optional AAOIFI Sharia compliance.

tools.name: pabandi_get_payment_status
tools.description: Query the lifecycle status, rail settlement confirmation, and ledger journal of an orchestrated payment by ID.

tools.name: pabandi_list_payment_rails
tools.description: List all active payment rails with live fee comparisons, average settlement speed, supported currencies, and Sharia compliance status.

tools.name: pabandi_simulate_rail_routing
tools.description: Simulate dynamic routing across the 4-layer payment stack to evaluate cost, speed, failover cascade, and savings against conventional processors.

tools.name: pabandi_get_ledger
tools.description: Look up a passport issuance charge by idempotencyKey (public audit). Returns feePab, ownerUserId, agentId, riskBand, capabilities, chargedAt. Example: {"idempotencyKey": "iss-3001"}

tools.name: pabandi_issue_passport
tools.description: Issue a scoped Agent Capability Passport (auth required via Bearer token from the owner). Capabilities validated against trust band. Metered at PAB_FEE_PER_PASSPORT $PAB per issue; idempotent via idempotencyKey. Example: {"agentId": "svc-agent-7", "capabilities": ["act:book", "read"], "idempotencyKe

tools.name: pabandi_open_session
tools.description: Open a Trust-Score-derived PabandiSession tab so the agent or user can transact repeatedly via pabandi_execute_transaction without per-call wallet signatures.

tools.name: pabandi_execute_transaction
tools.description: Spend against an open PabandiSession -- book a service, pay an invoice, or fund an escrow. REQUIRES a sessionId. tools.name: pabandi_get_services
tools.description: Get the verified service catalogue, pricing, deposit requirements, and Pabandi Trust Score for a business (by ID or slug). Use this before booking to inspect services and merchant reliability.

tools.name: pabandi_check_availability
tools.description: Check available appointment time slots and operating hours for a business on a specific date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns open slots, booked slots, and business hours.

tools.name: pabandi_create_booking
tools.description: Create a verified booking for an agent or customer. Automatically mints a Solana State-Compressed NFT (cNFT) Booking Credential and generates a Solana Pay transfer request (USDC/PAB) with an on-chain reference key for 400ms automatic settlement detection via findReference.

tools.name: pabandi_cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel an active booking by bookingId, update its cNFT credential status to CANCELLED, and release the time slot to the waitlist.

tools.name: pabandi_create_quote
tools.description: Create a dynamic milestone quote with programmable escrow for service businesses & contractors. Break down projects into phases (e.g. 30% deposit, 35% rough-in, 35% signoff) and generate a shareable checkout URL supporting Square, Solana Pay (USDC), and Raast.

tools.name: pabandi_list_properties
tools.description: Query properties, rental units, stay experiences, and leases available in Pabandi PropertyOS. Returns address, monthly/daily rate, bedrooms, bathrooms, and availability for AI agent bookings.

tools.name: pabandi_book_property
tools.description: Reserve or lease a property unit/stay experience in PropertyOS on behalf of a tenant or guest. Automatically verifies tenant trust risk band via CourtListener, allocates lease deposit into escrow, and issues a cNFT booking pass.

tools.name: pabandi_escrow_lock
tools.description: Lock funds in escrow (allocate memory). Creates a new escrow and funds it. Returns escrowId, status, and amount locked. This is the primitive agents use to put money on hold before work begins.

tools.name: pabandi_escrow_release
tools.description: Release locked escrow funds to the recipient. Requires escrowId. Deducts a 5% platform settlement rake and routes net payout to payee while recording platform revenue into the autonomous treasury.

tools.name: pabandi_escrow_create_child
tools.description: Create a child sub-escrow from a master escrow (parent-child subcontracting). Allocates a portion of master funds to a subcontractor. Returns childEscrowId and amount allocated.

tools.name: pabandi_trust_resolve
tools.description: Resolve the trust score and reputation for a passport/agent. Returns trustScore, tier, verifiedIdentity, and capability band. Used by agents to evaluate counterparties before transacting.

tools.name: pabandi_escrow_balance
tools.description: Check escrow balance and status. Returns status, totalAmount, releasedAmount, and platformFee.

tools.name: pabandi_m2m_post_project
tools.description: Post a machine-to-machine project to the marketplace. Creates an open project with escrow protection. Returns projectId and hireUrl. Used by agents to post work they need done.

tools.name: pabandi_session_close
tools.description: Close an open session and optionally settle remaining funds. Returns settlement summary.

tools.name: pabandi_session_receipts
tools.description: List all receipts (spend records) for a session. Returns the full spend history.

tools.name: pabandi_session_list
tools.description: List all sessions opened by an owner (user or agent). Returns sessions with balances and status.

tools.name: pabandi_identity_register
tools.description: Register an agent's identity onchain via ERC-8004. Creates a portable onchain identity that can be verified across the ecosystem. Returns the onchain agentId and transaction hash. Gasless for the agent (Pabandi pays gas).

tools.name: pabandi_identity_reputation_sync
tools.description: Sync an agent's trust score to the onchain ERC-8004 reputation registry. Posts feedback about completed tasks and success rate. Gasless for the agent (Pabandi pays gas).

tools.name: pabandi_discover_agents
tools.description: Discover agents by skills, trust score, and location. Returns agents sorted by relevance with trust scores and capability badges.

tools.name: pabandi_escrow_waterfall
tools.description: Check and trigger waterfall settlement for parent-child escrows. When all child escrows are released, the master escrow is marked completed. Returns settlement status.

tools.name: pabandi_scheduler_priority
tools.description: Get an agent's scheduling priority based on trust score. Returns tier, session limits, recommended actions, and match priority weight. Higher trust = better job matches and higher session limits.

tools.name: pabandi_agent_card
tools.description: Get an agent's A2A agent card (.well-known/agent.json equivalent). Returns capabilities, skills, trust score, and contact info for agent-to-agent discovery.

tools.name: pabandi_agent_registry
tools.description: Get the agent registry listing all discoverable agents on Pabandi. Returns agent handles, trust scores, and capabilities.

tools.name: pabandi_check_counterparty
tools.description: Check a counterparty's Trust Passport before bidding. Returns trustScore, tier, verifiedIdentity, and whether they clear a minimum score (default 500). Used by agents to evaluate who to transact with.

tools.name: pabandi_request_escrow
tools.description: Lock funds in escrow using an ERC-7710 delegated budget. Requires delegationId (from a prior grant) and amount. Verifies MaxAmount, Expiry, and AllowedContracts caveats before locking. Returns escrowId and remaining delegation budget.

tools.name: pabandi_submit_court_bundle
tools.description: Submit an EvidenceBundle to open an Internet Court adjudication case. Requires jobId, buyerClaim, sellerProof (IPFS/content hash), and optional oracleData. Returns the case id and status.

tools.name: pabandi_get_adjudication_status
tools.description: Check the status and verdict of an adjudication case. Returns status (pending/auto_executed/escalated), verdict, confidence, and reasoning.

tools.name: pabandi_verify_sd_jwt
tools.description: Verify a W3C VC / IETF SD-JWT selective-disclosure trust presentation (<issuer-jwt>~<disclosure_1>~<disclosure_2>~). Returns verified disclosed claims (trust_band, deposit_basis_points, zero_deposit_eligible) without exposing raw PII or exact score. Free public verification tool.

tools.name: pabandi_verify_ed25519_receipt
tools.description: Verify a Year-0 Ed25519 SignedTrustAttestation score receipt (modelHash, inputFeatureHash, predictedScore, trustBand, shapVectorHash, nonce, timestamp, signature). Confirms score and SHAP attribution integrity in under 1 ms.

tools.name: pabandi_book_contractor_escrow
tools.description: Book a high-ticket contractor milestone (e.g., Chicago Roofing, HVAC, or Commercial Security) with dynamic Trust-Band escrow pricing (Band A = $0 waived, Band B = 50% off, Band C = Standard, Band D = 1.25x capped at 50%). Returns reservationId, computed deposit, and Solana USDC escrow URI.

tools.name: pabandi_discover_platform
tools.description: Discover the full Pabandi Platform: every tool, OpenAPI/spec URL, MCP endpoint, PTP endpoints, SDK info, access tiers, and live status.

tools.name: pabandi_platform_access

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pabandi_discover, pabandi_issue_passport, pabandi_m2m_post_project, pabandi_get_business · Private data: pabandi_verify_passport, pabandi_issue_passport, pabandi_open_session, pabandi_execute_transaction, pabandi_create_booking, pabandi_cancel_booking, pabandi_session_receipts, pabandi_agent_card, pabandi_connect_finance, pabandi_zk_realestate_proof, pabandi_enrich_company · Public sink: pabandi_submit_dispute_evidence, pabandi_issue_passport, pabandi_m2m_post_project, pabandi_submit_court_bundle, pabandi_get_business, pabandi_predict_booking, pabandi_a2a_subscribe_alerts · Destructive: pabandi_execute_transaction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pabandi_discover, pabandi_issue_passport, pabandi_m2m_post_project, pabandi_get_business · Private data: pabandi_verify_passport, pabandi_issue_passport, pabandi_open_session, pabandi_execute_transaction, pabandi_create_booking, pabandi_cancel_booking, pabandi_session_receipts, pabandi_agent_card, pabandi_connect_finance, pabandi_zk_realestate_proof, pabandi_enrich_company · Public sink: pabandi_submit_dispute_evidence, pabandi_issue_passport, pabandi_m2m_post_project, pabandi_submit_court_bundle, pabandi_get_business, pabandi_predict_booking, pabandi_a2a_subscribe_alerts · Destructive: pabandi_execute_transaction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
